data.summary_en: ReTerm improves terminal agents' recovery from long-horizon execution errors: ReTerm-10K for SFT cold start, and ReTerm-GRPO, branching from failure states to generate multiple self-recovery attempts for online RL; ReTerm-9B (Qwen3.5-9B) reaches 34.8% Pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2.0, +14.6 points over base.
